title: Tanzanian Coconut Potato Curry
community: Zanzibar and coastal Tanzania — the coastal potato dish
author: Chef Fatuma
desc: Tanzanian Viazi vya Nazi — potatoes simmered in a fragrant coconut milk and Zanzibar spice sauce until completely tender and infused with the richness of the coast. The coastal Tanzanian potato dish — coconut milk transforms ordinary potatoes into something extraordinary.
longDesc: Viazi vya Nazi is what the Swahili coast does with potatoes — simmers them in coconut milk with Zanzibar spices until they absorb the fragrant, rich sauce completely. The result is a potato dish of unusual depth and richness.
steps: Heat oil. Cook onions until golden.
Add garlic, ginger, spices. Stir 1 minute.
Add tomatoes. Cook 6 minutes until thick.
Add potato cubes. Stir to coat.
Pour in coconut milk. Bring to a gentle simmer.
Simmer covered 18—20 minutes until potatoes are completely tender.
Some potato starch will naturally thicken the sauce.
chefTips: Potatoes naturally thicken the coconut sauce — no flour needed.
Do not stir too aggressively once potatoes are nearly tender — they break.
Never boil the coconut milk hard.
cookingScience: Potato starch dissolves into the coconut milk during cooking — creating a naturally thickened, slightly glossy sauce. The coconut fat simultaneously coats the potato surface, creating the characteristic rich, creamy result.
culturalNote: Viazi vya Nazi demonstrates the Swahili coast's most consistent cooking philosophy — add coconut milk to anything and make it magnificent. The humble potato becomes a feast food through this simple transformation.
